The character wears a long translucent flowing gown made of layered glassy petals and iridescent ribbons, with a sweeping train that curves from the lower center toward the right, blending into the flower field. Her hair and dress stream upward and outward in large ornate swirls, creating a halo-like spiral around her head; place a small vertical soft gray-brown rectangular blur over the face so the facial features are obscured. Use electric cyan, hot pink, violet, magenta, orange, gold, and deep sapphire blue with intense glow, high saturation, glossy highlights, and jewel-like refractions. Include exactly 11 prominent oversized butterflies: one golden butterfly at the upper left, one large cyan butterfly on the left side, one cyan butterfly near the upper center, one orange butterfly at the upper right, one cyan-pink butterfly at the far upper right, one large cyan butterfly on the right edge, one large magenta butterfly at the lower right, one blue butterfly near the lower right, one blue butterfly at the lower left, one orange-yellow butterfly near the lower left, and one pink-yellow butterfly on the mid-left; add many tiny secondary butterflies and petals as background detail. Surround the character with clustered flowers in pink, orange, purple, blue, and red, especially near the chest and along the dress. Style: premium Japanese AI fantasy illustration, ornate anime, stained-glass iridescence, hyper-detailed digital painting. Lighting should be radiant and magical, with thousands of tiny star sparkles and glowing outlines; make the image crisp, intricate, and highly polished. title: 月光神社魔法师决斗漫画
author: Flynn Ivy
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,漫画 / 图像小说,角色,群像 / 情侣,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime manga-style action comic page showing a magical duel at a moonlit Shinto shrine, with two rival sorcerers facing off using contrasting energy powers.

Canvas: Square 1:1 comic page with a thin white outer margin and four rounded-rectangle panels separated by white gutters. Use clean inked line art, cel-shaded anime coloring, dramatic night lighting, cool blue shadows, and glowing spell effects.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels. Panel 1 is a wide establishing shot across the full top half-width area, showing the shrine courtyard under a crescent moon. Panel 2 is another wide horizontal panel beneath it, a close action standoff. Panels 3 and 4 are two smaller equal-width panels along the bottom row.

Characters: Two young adult Japanese-style fantasy sorcerers. The left character is a female spellcaster named purple-robed shrine mage, wearing layered black and deep purple kimono-style robes, a purple sash, sandals, and dark hair tied back with purple ribbons; she casts glowing magenta paper talismans and violet barrier magic. The right character is a male spellcaster named green-robed wind sorcerer, wearing a dark green kimono robe with gold trim, loose hakama pants, sandals, short dark tousled hair, and glowing golden ring-like charms around his hands; he controls pale white wind spirals and golden energy loops. Keep both faces slightly simplified or softly obscured, not detailed portraits.

Panel details: Panel 1: wide establishing view of the shrine courtyard at night, stone paving, stairs, torii gates, lanterns, trees, shrine buildings, and a bright crescent moon centered high in the sky; the female mage stands on the left with violet talismans, the male wind sorcerer stands on the right with golden rings, both poised before the duel. Panel 2: close-up action composition, female on the left thrusting one hand forward while magenta paper talismans swirl around her, male on the right raising one hand defensively while a huge white wind vortex sweeps across the frame from right to left, with golden rings around his wrists. Panel 3: bottom-left impact panel, the female mage projects a bright purple circular portal or shield, while the male sorcerer counters with a sweeping golden wind arc that strikes the barrier, scattering dust, leaves, and sparks. Panel 4: bottom-right aftermath panel, both characters stand farther apart in the shrine courtyard; a vertical glowing purple oval barrier floats between them, the male watches from the right with golden hand loops, the moon and shrine steps visible behind them.

Visual style: polished anime comic illustration, dynamic perspective, expressive cloth motion, speed lines, glowing particles, transparent magical rings, high contrast between violet magic and golden wind, detailed shrine architecture, rounded black panel borders, no speech bubbles, no captions, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

Customization: Set the environment as a moonlit Shinto shrine courtyard, the female magic color as violet magenta, and the male magic color as gold and pale white.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed hyper-realistic vertical 9:16 cinematic luxury travel poster showing TÜRKİYE as a massive handcrafted floating island civilization suspended in soft atmospheric clouds, like a premium miniature world map and tourism masterpiece.

Canvas: Tall poster composition, off-white cloud background, elegant editorial layout. Use a grand navy serif headline at the top reading “TÜRKİYE”, with a refined subtitle beneath: “Where Continents, Civilizations & Nature Converge”. Add thin gold divider lines and a high-end museum-map aesthetic.

Top feature row: Under the subtitle, include exactly 4 small gold line icons with captions: 1) Rich Heritage — Thousands of years, 2) Breathtaking Nature — From seas to peaks, 3) Vibrant Culture — Timeless & welcoming, 4) Limitless Discovery — Every region, a new story.

Main subject: The entire country is visualized as one enormous floating island in the shape and spirit of Turkey, surrounded by turquoise seas, white clouds, waterfalls pouring off cliff edges, tiny boats, bridges, highways, rivers, forests, farmland, mosques, ruins, castles, mountain ranges, ancient cities, and modern urban districts. Make the island densely detailed and believable, with cinematic depth, warm sunlight, atmospheric haze, and miniature scale realism. Include airplanes flying above, seagulls, hot air balloons over Cappadocia, a Turkish flag near Ankara, another red flag near the southeast, and rich regional architectural variety.

Labeled landmarks and regions: Add exactly 18 cream-colored map labels with fine serif typography and subtle shadows, placed across the floating island: 1) ISTANBUL — Where Europe Meets Asia, 2) BURSA, 3) İZMİR — Pearl of the Aegean, 4) EPHESUS — Timeless Ancient City, 5) PAMUKKALE — Cotton Castle, 6) ANTALYA — Turquoise Coast’s Timeless Charm, 7) KONYA — Home of Mevlana, 8) ANKARA — The Capital, 9) SAMSUN, 10) CAPPADOCIA — Land of Fairy Chimneys, 11) TRABZON — Uzungöl, Sümela Monastery, 12) MOUNT ARARAT — 5,137 m, Türkiye’s Highest Peak, 13) ERZURUM, 14) VAN — Lake Van, 15) DIYARBAKIR — Ancient Walls, Timeless Stories, 16) GAZIANTEP — City of Gastronomy & Antep Baklava, 17) GÖBEKLİ TEPE — World’s First Temple, 12,000 Years Old, 18) MARDİN — Stone City of Mesopotamia.

Bottom information panel: Create a cream-and-gold bordered stats panel across the bottom with refined travel-brochure typography and exactly 8 information blocks: 1) Population: 85.7M with people icon, 2) Official Language: Turkish with speech icon, 3) Currency: Turkish lira ₺ / TRY with coin icon, 4) Visitors in 2024: 62.27M with suitcase icon, 5) Famous Exports: Automotive, Textiles, Machinery, Electronics, Hazelnuts with truck icon, 6) Cuisine: Kebab, Baklava, Meze, Tea, Turkish Coffee with serving-dome icon, 7) Transport: High-Speed Rail, Major Airports, Highways, Ferries, Bosphorus Bridges with train/plane icon, 8) Identity: CROSSROADS OF EUROPE AND ASIA — A bridge between worlds, a home beyond time, with globe icon.

Decorative foreground: At the lower right, place a realistic tulip-shaped glass of Turkish tea on a saucer beside a sesame simit bread ring; add delicate red tulips at both lower corners. Use gold accents, ivory margins, navy typography, and realistic shadows.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic miniature diorama, cinematic luxury tourism poster, ultra-detailed 3D cartographic illustration, premium travel magazine cover, crisp readable labels, natural atmospheric clouds, turquoise water, golden-hour highlights, extremely dense but organized details, no watermark, no extra text beyond the specified labels and captions.\

title: 三个美容手机登陆页面
author: Serene Gan
categories: 产品营销,应用 / 网页设计,3D 渲染,极简主义,产品,文字 / 排版
prompt_en: A polished promotional mockup showing 3 tall smartphone screens displayed side by side in a vertical triptych layout, each presenting a modern beauty brand landing page for a lip product. The overall composition is editorial, minimal, and premium, designed like a social media showcase of mobile web designs. The left panel sits on a soft lavender-to-blush gradient background and shows a black-framed phone with a cream and blush beauty website for Kosas. At the top of this panel, small elegant serif text reads Fresh Pout.. The phone screen features a cropped close-up beauty image at the top, a bold headline reading “Lips in their fullest expression.” with “fullest” in italic serif styling, a rounded dark call-to-action button, a strip of 3 lip close-up thumbnails, 3 labeled benefit tabs reading “Plumps,” “Tingles,” and “Shines,” and a row of 5 shade or effect icons underneath. The middle panel sits on a lavender-to-deep-violet gradient background and shows a second black-framed phone with a more typographic landing page. Above it, serif text reads Claude Code. The screen includes a cropped portrait image at top, a very large bold black stacked title reading “LIP PULSE.” with a pink italic script-style line “is here.” beneath it, a rounded dark button, a dark section with the phrase “Lips in their fullest expression.”, and a product grid near the bottom containing 6 shade cards arranged in 2 rows of 3. The right panel sits on a dark navy textured background and shows a third black-framed phone with a pink-forward e-commerce style page. Centered above it, monospaced white text reads GPT Images 2.0. This screen prominently displays the product hero section with the brand name “Kosas,” a large title “The Lip Pulse,” a pink lip gloss tube angled to the right, small feature icons, a shade strip of 6 lip swatches near the middle, and a lower promotional block with additional pink product imagery. Keep the layout symmetrical with exactly 3 phones, one per panel, each fully visible and vertically oriented. Use high-end cosmetic campaign aesthetics, clean spacing, fashion-web typography mixing serif and bold sans serif, soft pink and cream UI palettes, subtle shadows, and a sleek product-design presentation suitable for showcasing AI-generated mobile website concepts.\

title: 等距工作流程自动化插图
author: @はすきー｜MIDJOURNEYマニア🐺
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,产品营销,等距视角,插画,极简主义,图解 / 图表,角色
prompt_en: Create a clean isometric corporate website illustration on a white background, showing a stylized laptop at the center with a workflow automation diagram on its screen. A human figure in a red sweater, black pants, and white shoes stands to the right of the laptop, reaching forward and pressing a red rounded-square node on the screen. Use a modern vector/3D hybrid style with thick black outlines, soft gray shadows, white surfaces, and a limited palette of orange, red, black, and light gray. Include exactly 7 distinct surrounding objects connected by black circuit-like lines with small orange circular junctions: 1 large orange gear in the upper left behind the laptop screen, 1 small red gear on the right, 1 white rounded cube with an orange top tile in the upper right, 1 white/red rounded cube with a pie-chart icon in the lower left, 1 small white rounded cube with an orange check mark at the bottom center, 1 stacked white server-like cube with an orange top and small orange/red dots in the lower right, and 1 central laptop with a visible keyboard and trackpad. On the laptop screen include exactly 5 workflow UI elements: 2 red rounded-square nodes with white circular centers, 1 orange rounded rectangle in the middle, 1 white rounded rectangle with three small colored dots, and 1 black curved connector leading to the right red node. Keep the composition airy, minimal, friendly, and suitable as a corporate site hero asset for automation and digital workflow. No text, no logos, no photorealism, no clutter.\

title: 赛博朋克时尚杂志封面

prompt_en: Create a high-fashion cyberpunk magazine cover featuring a close-up street-style portrait of a young woman at night in a neon-lit capital city. She has long, thick cybernetic braids made of glossy black fiber-optic cables with blue, violet, and magenta highlights, metallic connector rings, and a circular tech ornament near one ear. Her face is intentionally covered by a square pixelated privacy block in muted brown-purple tones. She wears a black ribbed strappy top, a loose off-shoulder black leather jacket, and a wide futuristic chrome neck collar with panel details. In one hand she holds a small transparent cyberdeck or smartphone-like device with glowing blue interface graphics and attached cables running down into her outfit. The setting is a rainy urban night street with wet reflective pavement, blurred pedestrians, tall buildings, and colorful out-of-focus billboards and signs, photographed with shallow depth of field, cinematic bokeh, glossy reflections, and realistic editorial lighting. Design it as a fashion magazine cover with exactly 3 text elements: a huge thin white masthead at the top left reading NEURO, a small two-line caption at the top right reading FASHION SNAP\\nCAPITAL CITY NIGHT, and a tiny issue/date mark at the bottom left reading 2126 / SPRING. Use a vertical cover composition, premium cyber-fashion aesthetic, photorealistic detail, cool blue-purple neon palette, and crisp typography.\
